items.summary: Recommendation: keep SearchWoot private and do not authorize outreach, launch, credentials, spend, or production changes until Woot rights and Legal, Security, accuracy, and measurement gates are complete. Evidence: official Woot terms do not establish rights for public commercial display, derivatives, caching, or alerts; the checklist remains blocked. Unknown: whether Woot would grant written permission. Owner decision: choose A) authorize preparation of an unsent permission request, B) keep private with no outreach, or C) stop pursuing public beta.

Recommendation: prioritize three reversible SEO briefs across deeppenetrations.com, stinkyleftfoot.com, and aliencouncil.com, then measure before expanding. Evidence from the 30-day SEO snapshot: 585 impressions at position 4.1, 574 at 9.5, and 190 at 4.3 respectively; no attributable revenue lift is calculable. The fleet has 129 approved proposals without execution and zero proven improvements, so no new material scope is recommended this cycle.
